about: Lanbai / 蓝白 · Tentacle gate layout v4 (round 3 of the gate key art). Cloud art team -> Unity. Replaces the four tentacle groups of LB_Builder_Gate.cs (README_GateLayout.md). Shaders / C# uncompiled.
convention:
* Unity world: the bus is FIXED at the origin facing +Z; the world moves past it.
  * GateRoot local frame (all gate content is a child of GateRoot): origin = the ENTRY POINT, where the bus origin
    passes through the tear plane at U9 (15 % of the tear's height there, 150 m above the cloud-sea top); x right
    (seen from the bus), y up, z forward = away from the bus; the tear faces -Z (toward the bus).
  * GateRoot.position(t) = (0, gate_y(t), gate_z(t)), rotation 0, scale 1 (formulas below; Udon drives it).
  * Every instance's position / rotation is its FINAL pose (after rise / lean / track; before 'close');
    rotation_U7b_xyzw / position_U7b give the pose at U7b (the key art). Animations are relative to the final pose.
  * Arm meshes: GateArms_v3.fbx: per instance an empty <id> with three children <id>_LOD0 / _LOD1 / _LOD2 (Unity's
    importer builds one LODGroup per <id>). The arm form is BAKED (v4 custom centrelines for the heroes, girth,
    ridges <= 2 %) in the instance's own local space (UV0 'UVMap', UV1 'UVSway' (t, phase), UV2 'UVRadius' (x = the
    baked local radius / root radius: the shader's pixel rim, 1 px inflation and tip thresholds), vertex colour Col
    kept). Instance transform = position / rotation / uniform scale from here. Material = Lanbai/TentacleSway v2.4
    (_UseUVRadius 1, _Girth 1).

timeline.GateRoot_z: gate_z(t) = 59.0164 * (179.55 - t)   for t <= U9 (constant world speed, no ease: the arms are rooted in the cloud sea and would slide on it if the world eased).
timeline.GateRoot_active: round 3 (tech B1): SetActive(true) at t = U6 - 20 s = 113.80, while the bus is still inside the white cloud occluder (bible 1.9 / 6.3); every giant is then already STANDING in its final pose (no rise before U6 is ever seen) and hidden by its _Reveal = 0 (renderer off) and its cloud tower. Rises that start before activation: start the instance at its pose at activation (evaluate the rise at t = 113.80).
timeline.GateRoot_y: gate_y(t) = 150.0 - h_bus(t): the cloud-sea top is at world y = -h_bus(t)
timeline.h_bus: h_bus(t) = 40 (U6 - 20 <= t <= U6: GateRoot is only active from U6 - 20, inside the white cloud, where the act-3 climb has already brought the bus to the cloud-top layer); 40 + 20*smoothstep((t-U6)/(160.50-U6)) (U6..160.50); 60 + 90*smoothstep((t-160.50)/(U9-160.50)) (160.50..U9). Peak vertical acceleration 1.49 m/s^2 (bible 1.8: <= 1.5).
timeline.tear_H: monotone PCHIP through the knots; Tear_Root.localScale = H/1000

globals_every_frame._Udon_CloudTop: (x = -h_bus(t), w = 1): world y of the cloud-sea top (arms fade into it / clip below)
globals_every_frame._Udon_TearPos: (GateRoot.position + (0, -150 + 0.4 H(t), 0), w = 1): the tear core, world (round 2: replaces the per-material _TearPos constant)
globals_every_frame._Udon_TearH: (H(t), 0, 0, 1): the tear height (m) -- the fog colour's halo term
globals_every_frame._Udon_MoonDir: (direction TO the moon, world, w = 1): the fog colour's moon-air term and the rims

timeline.reference_camera: far plane >= 14 000 m (bible 1.4: 45 000; near 0.05): the tide is 5.7-13.3 km away at U7b and the background giants 3-8 km during act 3 (the current ReferenceCamera far 7 000 m clips them)

U6.cue: U6 + 13 s (last second of the Rilke line; colossus 2 rising left of the moon)
U6.note: U6_approach: tear ~14 deg tall inside the windscreen; Rilke line space +20/+3 left clear

U7.note: U7_engelein (the hero): the hands closing, the Engel bending over, colossus 2 taking the moon

U8fwd.cue: U8 + 3.5 s, straight ahead (bible acceptance frame)
U8fwd.note: U8_forward: the wound has outgrown the windscreen; the gate pillars have just passed

U8a.cue: U8 + 3.5 s (Ach nein! ... Ich liess mich nicht abweisen), looking up
U8a.note: U8a_ach_nein: the skylight (>= 18 % of the frame) full of the wound, which continues in the windscreen below

U8b.cue: U9 - 4 s: the skylight spot has walked up the aisle to the seats
U8b.note: U8b_spot: down the aisle: the wound's light falling through the skylight at your feet, its beam in the cabin dust

U8side.cue: U8 + 0.3 s: the right gate pillar slides past the side windows (abeam)
U8side.note: U8_side (round 3): the right gate pillar abeam-behind: its foot, its cloud dome and sleeve in the side glass, the body rising and cut by the window header (side deck impostor side3)

rear.cue: U9 - 2 s (just before Ich bin von Gott): the hand closes behind
rear.note: rear_window: the Orpheus shot, arms closing behind the bus over a front-lit silver plain (moon behind the viewer, the arms' long shadows run to the horizon)

key.cue: U7b - 0.6 s (key art: colossus 2 has taken ~87 % of the moon, a sliver remains)
key.note: keyart_239: the U7 moment without the bus shell

tear.direction: from _Udon_TearPos toward the bus each frame

sky_band.elevation: w_el = (1 - smoothstep(12, 34, el))^5  (_BandEl = (12, 34, 5); round 3, awe B7.2: full to ~+13, 0.17 at +20, ~0 by +26, void from +34: the top of the frame is night)
sky_band.below_horizon: x lerp(0.55, 1, smoothstep(-25, 0, el)); and toward a cold grey: lerp(band, luminance x (0.92, 0.98, 1.12), 0.6 x smoothstep(0, -4, el)) (_BelowDesat 0.6: the air over the cloud sea is moonlit silver, not lavender)

fog.height_extra: density x (_FogDensityScale + _FogExtra.x exp(-(y - y_cloud) / _FogExtra.y)), _FogExtra = (1.5, 25) on every material (shader v2.4 adds it; v2.3 multiplied it: tech B3)
fog.per_instance: instances[*].material._FogDensityScale; the reveal is instances[*].reveal (after the cap)
fog.cap: hero / colossus / bg / surge: beyond 1.3-1.7 km min(f, 0.92) x exp(-(y - y_cloud) / 5000 m); then the reveal: f = 1 - (1 - f) x _Reveal
fog.color: LanbaiHorizon(view dir) + 0.35 x the moon aureole (#8FA3C8 x (1.6 e^-0.9a + 0.06 e^-0.32a)) + 0.35 x the three halo cards' profile at the ray's crossing of the tear plane (points in front of it only): shader v2.4 LanbaiFogColour, globals _Udon_MoonDir / _Udon_TearPos / _Udon_TearH
fog.cloud_top: arms: the last 25 m (+-15 m noise) above _Udon_CloudTop.x fade toward _CloudTopColor = fill (0.026, 0.030, 0.038) under the same fog; clip below cloudTop - 5 m

rim_ladder: rim x exp(-0.0006 d) x clamp((900/d)^1.2, 0.12, 1) x (0.6 + 0.8 wet) x _RimGain; only on light-facing edges of a BACK-LIT arm (moon: saturate(N.L) and the moon in front of the view; wound: facing it and it in front); width _RimPx

tide.atlas: run 6: gate/Textures/TentacleTide_v3_Atlas_A/B.png + TentacleTide_v3_Atlas.json (v4 arm form: swan necks curling over in the top third; 8 single arms + 8 clusters of 3-5 arms; alpha feathered over the bottom 7 %). The v2 atlases (deliver/Tentacles/Textures) are superseded for the gate: their thin blades in a row read as grass.
tide.placement: run 6: 360 quads 4.8-12 km from the tear, |az| 24-70 (clear of the wound foot and the hands), grouped in surges along the azimuth (haze gaps between masses) and crest rows 600 m apart; taller toward the wound; roots sunk 40-160 m (sink_m); each base dissolves over its own mist_height_m (60-180 m): alpha x saturate((y_above_cloud_top + 8) / mist)^1.6 (UV6 "TideMist" x = mist height, y = sink)
tide.lean: each blade leans lean_deg toward the wound
tide.fog: round 3: 58 % at the base, 48 % at the tips (min(fog, lerp(0.58, 0.48, smoothstep(0, 400, height)))): a contrast of -4..-6 L* against the band (the 80-92 % of the bible left the tide invisible); the atlas colour x 0.3 (the painted rim never brighter than the sky); clip below _Udon_CloudTop.x - 2

reveal.how: material _Reveal (all blades): the wave recedes into the haze U8 - 5 .. U8 + 1; disable the renderer at 0

tide.rise: each blade rises only its visible part (size x cos(lean) + 40 m) over 14 s, the outermost first (U6 + 10 .. U7): the tide is on screen at U7b; crest speed in motion_check.json

shafts.note: round 3: TWO beams (one per gap, unequal 1.0 / 0.6), each one soft lobe across (no striation finer than 1.5 deg: Shaft_Gradient v4), from the lens at 38-44 % of its height up and out into the void, ending by el +21; widen x3.2 by 1.5 km; depth-tested

shadow_wedges.note: dark wedges in the haze band behind each bundle (alpha 0.15-0.25): the band alternates lit and shadowed like crepuscular rays in fog; camera-facing about the axis

tear.kit: deliver/Tear kit v4 (round 3: no nested lips; the bible falloff + a cloth thickness on the right edge + 4 inner veils; left edge clean, right ragged; TWO thin welded flaps (outer face = the sky colour) whose rolled lips the hands grip (tented); a zipper of 9 bridging threads across the top 16 % (2 snapped) and a hairline running on into the dark; tension folds (Tear_SkyFolds v4); dark-lipped branch rips; an inner halo card x 2.8; README_Tear.md)
tear.grips: the fingertips of Hand_L0/L2 and Hand_R0/R2 end on tear_def.GRIPS (kit space, moved with the opening like the flaps): they hold the cloth through the approach (track keys to U9 - 1). Run 6: Hand_L1 and Hand_R1 are WHIPS that cross the white in front of the lens (y -30 m in the tear frame) and hook the OPPOSITE lip (L1 -> right lip at 24 % H, R1 -> left lip at 36 % H; gate_layout.CROSS), tracked to that lip point (u 0.93) until U9 - 1: the fingertips interlace over the wound as if closing it, and it keeps opening

crevasse.walls: x 0.30 darker (run 6: the foot's own split, 240 m; the 700 m crevasse read as a crack / river drawn to the camera)
crevasse.unity: Tear_Foot: 3 alpha cards on the cloud top along -Z from the foot (or a decal-like additive strip at cloud-top height) + Tear_CloudGlow

clouds.note: Renders use one volumetric impostor of the cloud deck to 9 km (cloud_deck.py gate3 / rear3); in Unity the cloud sea is the Clouds kit (CloudSea strips + cards) moving at v_g.
clouds.pool: the pool LIGHTS the cloud (v3b): Tear_CloudGlow_Lit (Blend DstColor One: dst x (1 + glow), _Tint linear (0.607, 0.683, 1.144) = the #495270 hue at luminance 0.7) + Tear_CloudGlow additive at _Intensity 0.25, at cloud-top height, #495270 target: weight = 0.75 exp(-(r/420)^2) + 0.25 exp(-r/900) (r = distance from (0, 150 x S) in the tear frame) x Tear_CloudLanes_1024.png (x0..x1 = -2000..2000 m across, y0..y1 = -2400..1600 m along, GateRoot frame shifted by -z of the foot)
clouds.lanes_png: Textures/Tear_CloudLanes_1024.png (R: 1 = lit, 0.15 = in a root shadow; row 0 = far)
clouds.root_dissolve: run 6: the arms' roots dissolve in the lowest ~18 m of their _CloudFade zone (noisy alpha: Unity = dithered clip / alpha-to-coverage on the same noise, over the cloud cards); the root sleeve cards below are RETIRED (at the hand roots their streaks read as a striped band with a straight top)
clouds.sleeves_retired: round 3 (awe B6.1): no crisp collars. Per arm beyond 400 m a SLEEVE (Textures/Gate_RootSleeve_512.png, a soft dome 1.2-1.8 x the root diameter, 30-60 m high, with mist 60-150 m up the body, ragged top, edges >= 6 px soft), tinted from the deck: gate_scene.sleeve_specs / root_sleeves
clouds.collars_retired: root collars: 2-3 Cloud_Puff / Cloud_Cumulus cards per arm where it leaves the cloud (1.5-2.2 x its diameter wide, >= 50 m, yaw billboards, queue 3000, colour = card luminance x (0.92, 0.98, 1.12) x 1.3 in LanbaiFog, the card's cloud base on the cloud-sea top); not on the 3 near arms (at 10-50 m a puff card reads as rocks); alpha x smoothstep(8, 5, depression angle from the eye in deg): seen from above (U8, eye 80-150 m up) a vertical puff card reads as a heap of rocks: gate_scene.collar_specs

far.role: bank far left of the tear
bank far right of the tear

horizon_relief.note: run 6: 22 low moonlit cloud masses 4.2-9.5 km out (|az| 14-70, 90-230 m showing above the deck), interleaved with the tide rows so the far arms rise from behind cloud heads at different heights (a flat far deck made a ruler-straight horizon on which every base sat). Same material as "far" (yaw billboard, card colour in LanbaiFog, no cap, base melting over its lowest 130 m), queue 2990.

towers.note: round 3 (awe B8): every colossus is born inside a towering cumulus card standing on the deck at its root, a little in front of it (deliver/Clouds; yaw billboard, queue 3000, colour = the card in LanbaiFog with no cap, opacity 0.92). After the instance's reveal starts, the tower SAGS (localScale.y 1 -> 0.72, pivot at its base) and thins (alpha 1 -> 0.8) over 25 s: the arm has dragged cloud down with it. Pour-off sheets (2-3 Cloud_Wisp cards sliding down the body over 10-15 s) are optional.

near_wake.note: round 3 (tech M10): the near arms move with the bus, so their roots travel through the cloud at 52-66 m/s. Per near arm: a BOW PUFF (Cloud_Puff_moon, 1.5 x the root diameter wide) riding with the root at the cloud top, plus a trail: every 0.6 s emit a Cloud_Wisp_moon / Cloud_Puff_moon card at the root (width 1.2-2 x the root diameter), left behind at WORLD speed (it moves with GateRoot), fading alpha 0.8 -> 0 over 4 s (6-7 alive per arm), queue 3000, unlit, LanbaiFog colour.

moon.beat: '...und wollt' mich abweisen': colossus 2's upper body (u 0.2-0.4, ~1.6 deg wide at 2.6 km) comes down across the 1.2 deg disc
moon.udon_rule: the disc is >= 90 % covered over [U7b, U7b + 1.5] (run 6 table: 0.96 at U7b, 1.00 at U7b + 0.5, 0.93 at U7b + 1.5, 0.89 at U7b + 2.0): START the fade of the skybox moon DISC at U7b + 1.5 and take it out over 2 s (EV-linear), leaving the halo #5A6A88 (Lanbai/Sky halo term) on: the moon is TAKEN. The track keys keep the body near the halo for a few more seconds; then parallax carries it left of the empty halo.
moon.aureole: Lanbai/Sky moon halo: fill = #8FA3C8 x (1.6 exp(-0.9 a) + 0.06 exp(-0.32 a)), a = angle from the disc centre in degrees (L* ~55 at 1 deg, the band by ~8 deg); LanbaiFog adds 0.35 x the same term

glory.note: round 3 (awe rear): the rear window's scale anchor. An ADDITIVE card lying on the cloud top at the anti-moon point, a child of NearRoot (it travels with the bus): position = (-Lm.x d, -h_bus(t), -Lm.z d) with Lm = the horizontal direction to the moon (Unity), d = h_bus(t) / tan(8 deg) (~1.07 km at U9). Seen from the bus: a colourless ring of radius 3.2 deg (+0.75 x the cloud luminance, width 0.75 deg) + a 1.7 deg core (+0.40) and, at the centre, a 0.3 deg dark spot (x 0.45): the bus's own shadow. C* <= 6, queue 3001, unlit; size the card so 3.2 deg at distance d spans its ring.

skylight_spot.note: bible 4.8: the skylight corners projected along (corner - tear core) onto the floor (y = 0.623); additive UnlitCardHDR #E2E8F3, display luma 170-200. Round 3 (awe B9.3): the card is drawn 0.22 m larger on every side (penumbra) and shaded as the aperture convolved with the INVERTED wound: a soft lens longer along the aisle (box feather from 55 % of the half size, lens 0.35 -> 1.0 inside (du/0.80)^2 + (dv/1.05)^2 < 1, v = along the aisle), x (0.86 + 0.14 floor studs 25 mm / 50 mm); beam = the prism skylight -> spot (additive, ~4 % at the floor), 300 dust motes inside it

near_root: near arms (frame bus) are fixed to the bus, not to GateRoot; see instances[*].how
